🇬🇧 WHAT'S FIXED IN 7.8.2

🐛 WHITE SCREEN — FINALLY FIXED

• Built apps no longer freeze on white screen at startup
• Automatic blocking logcat initialization disabled
• Logcat starts 2 seconds after launch, doesn't affect work

📋 OTHER

• Fixed on all Android versions
• Stable app launch
